featureAuthorities.name: RNICA shadcn/ui adoption rule
featureAuthorities.requiredWhen: RNICA UI component implementation using shadcn/ui primitives

featureAuthorities.name: SNS Clinical Readability Standard
featureAuthorities.requiredWhen: Any major UI redesign, any new workflow, any dashboard, any reporting screen, any billing workflow, any tenant-owner workflow, any administrator workflow, any compliance workflow, any clinical workflow, any responsive-layout work, or any typography change, across the Clinical Platform, Owner/Tenant/Biller Platform, and Administrator UI (not limited to Body Systems)

featureAuthorities.name: SNS Clinical Workspace Standard
featureAuthorities.requiredWhen: Any viewport/device-support decision for any SNS UI (clinical, billing, tenant-owner, administrator, QA/compliance, executive/reporting dashboards) — ultrawide, laptop, tablet, phone (not limited to Body Systems)

featureAuthorities.name: SNS Browser Width Validation Standard
featureAuthorities.requiredWhen: Approving any major SNS UI redesign or new workflow across the Clinical Platform, Owner/Tenant/Biller Platform, and Administrator UI, including any responsive-layout work or browser-validation work (not limited to Body Systems)

featureAuthorities.name: SNS Playwright Validation Standard
featureAuthorities.requiredWhen: Selecting or using a browser-automation/visual-validation tool for any major SNS UI work across the Clinical Platform, Owner/Tenant/Biller Platform, and Administrator UI (not limited to Body Systems)
